meta.name: Ashkettle Caldera
meta.note: Generated by tools/genworld.mjs; safe to hand-edit.

hello.text: Brin. Ash dries timber mean and straight. Your house can rise twice over on its own floor plan, with joints cut for the kettle winds.

menu.text: The footprint stays exactly where it is. We build upward, and every new floor is yours to use.

choices.text: I need 1800 coin for the second story.
I need 3600 coin for the third story.

second.text: Two stories, sound and square. The new stair is ready inside.

third.text: Three stories. Roof raised, chimney drawn, top floor ready. That house is complete.

complete.text: Complete at three stories. Any higher and it stops being a house and starts arguing with the weather.

short.text: Keep the plan. Come back when the purse is ready; the ground will not move.

endline.text: No harm done. A measured house waits better than people do.

text: Do not drink it. It is warm and it is wrong and everyone tries it once.
Ro. I sit with the lake. Somebody kept falling in before I did.

choices.text: What is on the other side?

text: The rest of the road, and you get there by walking round it like everybody else.
The lake looks like a shortcut for about a week and then it stops looking like one.

hot.text: Because we live in the top of something that has not entirely finished.

trade.text: I skim them. Four is a good afternoon. There.

text: You came up. Good. Everything up here is better than everything down there.
Tally. I keep the benches -- what will root in cinder, which is not much and knows it.

again.text: Up again. It is the only way out of a bowl, going up.

gift.text: On the warm side of the stones. Take them, they will not keep.

text: A ring of wall, four steps of bench, a floor, and a lake in the hole of it.
There is no outside. People take a while with that and then they stop minding.

props.name: Vesper
props.title: Has the far side to herself

text: You walked the whole way round. Nobody does that twice by accident.
Vesper. The door is yours now -- there is a fire in it and nothing else to recommend it.
It is in the middle of the floor and the room is round, so there is no bad seat. That is the whole design.

welcome.text: Far side today, same as every day. Fire is in, go and sit at it.

text: I saw the shutter from the path and for about two seconds I thought somebody had answered.

choices.text: What is the lamp on the post?

why.text: Because from here the town is a thing I can look at, and from there it is a thing I am in.

trade.text: Firewood grows badly here and burns fine. That is fair for three.

text: A signal lamp, and there is nobody signalling back, and I light it most nights anyway.
Light it yourself if you are in there. The shutter is stiff. Long, short, long -- that one means nothing, I made it up.
Because a corner is somewhere the fire does not reach and I have only the one fire.
Walled the four of them off my first winter. Best day's work I have done and the least of it to look at.
Ro walks round about twice a year and complains about the distance the entire way.
You have been over more times than that already. I am not making a thing of it. I am just saying I counted.
